statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = true if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < len(ghosts), |ghosts[i][0] - target[0]| + |ghosts[i][1] - target[1]| > |target[0]| + |target[1]|. Equivalently, r = false if and only if there exists i with 0 <= i < len(ghosts) such that |ghosts[i][0] - target[0]| + |ghosts[i][1] - target[1]| <= |target[0]| + |target[1]|.
preconditions: len(target) = 2; 1 <= len(ghosts) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(ghosts), len(ghosts[i]) = 2; every coordinate appearing in target or in any ghosts[i] lies in the interval [-10000, 10000].

statement: The function returns a result r for every input satisfying the preconditions; it does not overflow, panic, or perform an out-of-bounds access.

statement: Whenever escape_ghosts(ghosts, target) returns r1 and escape_ghosts(ghosts2, target) returns r2, r1 = r2.
